resumo: The bath, the feed, the walk home. Nobody films the ordinary because it feels like it will last forever, and the ordinary is what vanishes without warning.

secoes.texto: We film birthdays, holidays and firsts. We do not film the seven in the morning nappy change, the middle-of-the-night feed, the walk to nursery. And that is exactly what disappears completely, because it is what feels like it will last forever.

itens: A whole meal, start to finish, with the mess and your patience running out.
The bedtime ritual, with the song you use.
Twenty seconds of the bath, with the voice of whoever is giving it.
The walk from home to somewhere you go every week.
The corner of the house where she spends the most time, filmed slowly, with nobody in the frame.

secoes.texto: A short clip, landscape, without talking to the camera. Do not ask her to look or call her name: it is the natural scene that has value, and it dies the moment anyone notices they are being filmed.

Today's routine will no longer exist six months from now. It is not growth that erases it, it is replacement: every stage swaps the whole routine, and the previous one disappears without anyone having recorded a thing.
